title: Storage
description: Object storage: a Storage service on R2 with Worker-served signed download URLs, and a dashboard card.

envVars.name: STORAGE_SIGNING_SECRET
envVars.description: HMAC secret for signed download URLs (wrangler secret put STORAGE_SIGNING_SECRET)

args.name: storage

args.content:
## Storage

- Use the `Storage` service from `@repo/core` (put, get, list, delete, signedUrl, verify); do not touch the R2 binding directly. Programs that use it (`upload`, `listUploads`, `deleteUpload`) live next to it in `packages/core/src/storage.ts`.
- The layer is `StorageLive` in `apps/web/src/server/storage.ts`, on the `STORAGE` R2 binding; downloads are served by the Worker route in `storage-route.ts`. The dashboard card's server functions are in `apps/web/src/server/storage-demo.ts`.
- Signed URLs are HMAC-signed with the `STORAGE_SIGNING_SECRET` secret (at least 32 characters; the app fails to start without it). Never log or return it.
- Storage keys are opaque: generate them on the server, never from raw user input. Files are served as attachments with `nosniff`, inline only for raster images.
- Test with `StorageInMemory` from `packages/core/test/storage-in-memory.ts` (`layer(StorageInMemory)` from `@effect/vitest`), as `storage.test.ts` does; do not mock R2.
- On auth stacks efforge chains `.middleware([requireSession])` on the card's server functions in `storage-demo.ts`; gate any server function you add that reads or writes the bucket the same way.

### Storage without auth

- While this project has no auth, the upload and delete server functions in `apps/web/src/server/storage-demo.ts` are open: anyone who can reach the app can store files in the bucket. Add auth (`efforge add auth/better-auth`, which guards them) or remove the demo before deploying.
